paragraphs: The X1 sDrive18d and xDrive20d are part of the second-generation (F48) X1 range, produced from 2015 to 2022. These variants use BMW's modern B-series diesel family — the B37 1.5-litre 3-cylinder in the sDrive18d, and the B47 2.0-litre 4-cylinder in the xDrive20d. Both are generally reliable engines with no major documented failure patterns, and we rebuild them to the same exacting standard as every BMW engine that comes through our workshop.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 xDrive20d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because BMW X1 xDrive20d can use the B37 or B47 engine code, fitting the wrong replacement risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (B37 or B47) via registration or VIN
Your generation (F48 — these are the second-generation X1 models)
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X1 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
